compactRecord.rs: Best panorama in Ise-Shima National Park; pearl-raft mosaic featured at the 2016 G7 summit.
compactRecord.td: Ria coastline studded with 60+ pine-clad islets and rafts of cultured-pearl oysters. Yokoyama Observatory deck at 203 m (Ise-Shima National Park) gives the panorama chosen for the 2016 G7 summit briefing photos.
